data.one_liner: Tiled map support for the Flame game engine
data.what_it_does: Bridges the tiled library into easy-to-use Flame components, providing wrappers and components to render Tiled maps inside Flame games.
use_when: You are building a 2D game using Flame and Tiled map editor
You need to load and render tile maps and layers inside your Flame game
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine
You do not use Tiled for level design
strengths: Seamless integration with Flame game engine
Supports dynamic layer opacity, package assets, and custom properties from Tiled
weaknesses: May experience extra lines while rendering under the current sprite batch implementation due to a Flutter bug
Requires using the Flame game engine and Tiled maps
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and configure your assets for Tiled map files.

alternatives.name: flame
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are building a game in Flame without Tiled map requirements.
